dataset_name: Labour force characteristics, monthly, seasonally adjusted and trend-cycle
description: Monthly Labour Force Survey estimates of employment, unemployment, the unemployment rate and participation and employment rates, by sex and age group, seasonally adjusted and trend-cycle. The hub uses it to track labour-market stress, a leading driver of household credit risk.
access: Public. Free download, no account or API key required.
access_format: CSV in a ZIP archive (full-table download from a REST API)
retrieval_method: Statistics Canada Web Data Service (WDS) REST API: getFullTableDownloadCSV returns the full-table CSV zip (data and table description); getCubeMetadata returns the title, release time, frequency and expected number of data points.
geography: 11 geographies in source; processed file: Canada
update_frequency: monthly (Labour Force Survey, released early in the following month at 08:30 ET)
refresh_schedule: on Labour Force Survey release days, after 08:30 ET
